title: Yes…. But…
body: Yes, it’s python, but the free version is extremely limited. You can’t even save a file and come back to it later. The “interpreter” window lets you see only the first fifty or so lines of output. Whether this behavior is due to App Store rules or is just coercion to go for the $4 a month auto renewing subscription I don’t know. But it bothers me to see totally open source Python subject to this level of gatekeeping.
